scenarios.user_does: Opens the app for the first time.
scenarios.expected: Home shows Breath, Ground, Journal and an optional check-in. No 'Your usual' yet.
scenarios.observed: 4 check-in choices shown, 'Your usual' shown: False.

scenarios.user_does: Taps the check-in 'Wound up'.
scenarios.expected: Screen shrinks to one suggestion (Breath reset) plus 'Show all options'.
scenarios.observed: 1 activity button visible; suggestion is Breath reset: True.

scenarios.user_does: Taps 'Show all options' after choosing 'Wound up'.
scenarios.expected: All three activities come back. The person can override the app's narrowing.
scenarios.observed: 3 activity buttons visible.

scenarios.user_does: Changes the check-in to 'Scattered'.
scenarios.expected: Ground reset becomes the suggestion at the top; the others stay available.
scenarios.observed: Suggested: Ground reset.

scenarios.user_does: Changes the check-in to 'Low'.
scenarios.expected: Journal becomes the suggestion at the top.
scenarios.observed: Suggested: Journal.

scenarios.user_does: Taps 'Clear' on the check-in.
scenarios.expected: Normal home screen; the profile shows no current check-in.
scenarios.observed: Check-in choices back on screen; profile check-in = None.

scenarios.user_does: Does a full Breath reset with press and hold.
scenarios.expected: Completes in about 66 s (plan), saved as completed with breaths followed.
scenarios.observed: status=completed, duration=66.008 s, breaths_detected=6.

scenarios.user_does: Does a Breath reset with the microphone (simulated breath-out sound).
scenarios.expected: Breaths are noticed and saved, but the Done screen shows no count or score.
scenarios.observed: breaths_detected=6 saved; Done screen mentions a count: False.

scenarios.user_does: Chooses Microphone but the browser denies microphone access.
scenarios.expected: Stays on setup, explains it, and switches to press and hold.
scenarios.observed: Note shown: 'Couldn't use the microphone, so you can press and hold the circle instead.'. Hold selected: True.

scenarios.user_does: Opens 'Need help now' in the middle of a Breath reset, closes it.
scenarios.expected: Exercise pauses while the panel is open; that time is not counted in the exercise duration.
scenarios.observed: 'paused' shown: True; paused_ms=4083, active_ms=6563, wall_ms=10653.

scenarios.user_does: Taps Stop partway through.
scenarios.expected: Neutral 'You stopped. That's fine.' screen; saved as stopped, not as a failure.
scenarios.observed: status=stopped, steps_completed=1; screen says: 'You stopped. That's fine.'.

scenarios.user_does: Does a Ground reset, tapping once every 2.5 s (the planned pace).
scenarios.expected: One sense per screen, no typing; finishes under 90 s.
scenarios.observed: status=completed, measured 42.087 s.

scenarios.user_does: Comes back home after finishing two Breath resets and one Ground reset.
scenarios.expected: 'Your usual: Breath reset' appears without any setup.
scenarios.observed: Shown: 'Your usual: Breath reset'.

scenarios.user_does: Fictional user 'Maya' saves her name and 'swimming', checks in as Scattered, and writes she is overwhelmed about a swim meet.
scenarios.expected: Reply is calm, uses her name once, offers her usual reset as an option; context shows name, activity, check-in, usual.
scenarios.observed: Reply: "Thanks for writing, Maya. That sounds like a lot to hold at once. If it would help, your usual Breath reset is there and takes about a minute. Or you can keep writing here." Context has name/activity/check-in: True.

scenarios.user_does: Writes 'this workout block is killing me'.
scenarios.expected: Treated as a figure of speech: normal reply, no crisis panel.
scenarios.observed: Crisis panel opened: False.

scenarios.user_does: Writes a crisis-related sentence in the Journal (fictional).
scenarios.expected: Crisis panel opens at once; fixed message; model not called; both messages flagged.
scenarios.observed: Panel open; model calls before/after: 2/2; flags: [1, 1].

scenarios.user_does: Writes indirect wording: 'I just want to disappear for good'.
scenarios.expected: Known limit: the phrase list does not catch this. The Need help now button must still be there.
scenarios.observed: Panel opened automatically: False; Need help now visible: True.

scenarios.user_does: Turns off 'Let the companion see my past journal entries'.
scenarios.expected: Context no longer includes earlier entries and tells the model not to mention them.
scenarios.observed: Earlier entry text in context: False; 'turned off' note: True.

scenarios.user_does: The model fails (switched to fail mode), then the user writes in the Journal.
scenarios.expected: Fallback lines on home and in the Journal; message still saved; crisis panel still works.
scenarios.observed: Home line source=fallback; journal reply source=fallback; crisis panel opened: True.

scenarios.user_does: Turns on Larger text, then reloads the app.
scenarios.expected: Text stays larger after reload because the setting is saved.
scenarios.observed: Larger text after reload: True.

scenarios.user_does: Opens History.
scenarios.expected: Shows each reset with Done/Stopped and length, and each journal entry by its first line.
scenarios.observed: 7 items listed.

scenarios.user_does: The backend is stopped; the user opens the app, opens Need help now, and starts a Breath reset.
scenarios.expected: Crisis panel works (static); exercise still runs and says it isn't being saved.
scenarios.observed: Crisis panel opened: True; exercise running: True; 'not saved' note: True.
